subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Multi-Level Marketing's Gray Zone
description: Learn Multi-Level Marketing's Gray Zone in one minute.

hook.text: Multi-level marketing companies insist they're legitimate. Critics say they're legal pyramids.

buildup.text: MLMs sell real products, but most distributor income comes from recruiting new sellers.

discovery.text: FTC research found that in many MLMs, over 99% of participants lose money.

twist.text: MLMs survive legally because they technically sell products — even if most are bought by sellers themselves.

climax.text: The line between a legal MLM and an illegal pyramid scheme is blurry — and heavily lobbied.

punchline.text: A product doesn't make a pyramid scheme legitimate.

quiz.question: What did FTC research find about most MLM participants?
